criteria.requirement: Implement dpath.patches.apply_edits(root,operations) using completed get_exact for typed literal paths. Materialize operations first and work on a deep copy. Support add/replace/remove/test; dictionary add sets a key, replace/remove require it, list add inserts at 0..len and remove compacts. Reject bool/negative list indices; test compares recursive types and values so True differs from 1. Empty path may test or replace/add root, but cannot remove root. Any later invalid operation, failed test or enumeration error leaves original unchanged; copy incoming mutable values and do not reinterpret paths as globs.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
